item.title: Anthropic Announces Successful IPO and Concurrent Private Placement
item.description: Anthropic completed its IPO, selling 1.127 billion shares at $83 each, raising $93.5 billion. It also sold 313 million shares in a private placement for $26 billion. This raises capital for Anthropic's continued growth and development in AI technology. — Upstream (Anthropic News): https://www.anthropic.com/news/ipo-close

item.title: Prompt: “Paint an exact copy of Manet’s Folies-Bergère”. An AI paints it in oil from Python…
item.description: I built aibrush, a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) oil-painting engine made specifically for Claude and other strong models. It runs the full test suite from the exact commit, then looks at crops of its own test strokes next to real paintings at 1:1 and 4x. It's not an image generator and not a filter. — Upstream (r/ClaudeAI): https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1y1d6r8/prompt_paint_an_exact_copy_of_manets/

item.title: Agents using GPT-6.2 in the Responses software connections can build on earlier reasoning to…
item.description: Starting with our newest frontier models, each reasoning item is now tied to the conversation history before it, so editing earlier messages causes the software connections to drop reasoning that follows the change. Cuts live answering work compute overhead and tail response wait time on production workloads without sacrificing task accuracy. — Upstream (X · @OpenAIDevs): https://x.com/OpenAIDevs/status/2123566018866151579

item.title: Google introduces Gemini 4 Neon for complex coding and analysis at lower cost
item.description: Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon, which offers advanced coding and analysis capabilities at a lower cost compared to previous versions. The new model aims to address the need for more powerful coding tools without the high costs associated with advanced AI systems. — Upstream (Google DeepMind): https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing-gemini-4-neon/

item.title: Ollama v0.40.17-rc3
item.description: The release v0.40.17-rc3 of Ollama includes support for various AI models such as Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, and others. It also adds support for Inkling 2 Mini Assets, though there were some loading errors reported. The update aims to provide a more comprehensive and flexible platform for experimenting with different AI models, addressing the need for a versatile and open-source AI development environment. — Upstream (ollama Release): https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.40.17-rc3

item.title: OpenAI Codex v0.173.0-alpha.2
item.description: OpenAI released a new version of Codex, version 0.173.0-alpha.2, which is a pre-release version intended for testing and feedback. The release aims to improve the functionality and usability of the coding assistant, addressing potential issues from the previous version. — Upstream (openai/codex Release): https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.173.0-alpha.2

item.title: Test Qwen4-Max on Nous Portal and showcase your creations
item.description: Qwen4-Max, a new AI model from Alibaba, is available for free on the Nous Portal for 5 days in partnership with @inferact. It addresses the need for businesses and individuals to test and utilize advanced AI models for various applications. — Upstream (X · @Alibaba_Qwen): https://x.com/Alibaba_Qwen/status/2123328957022081036

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.329
item.description: What's changed Added a trust dialog warning that says where a folder's hooks are declared Added a warning in the conversation, in Claude Desktop and other non-interactive hosts, when hooks in managed settings fail to load Added this session's scheduled tasks, /loop wakeups, the goal and this conversation's forks to /tasks; x stops one. Eliminates manual context switching and bespoke glue scripts across multi-file repositories and external developer tools. — Upstream (claude-code Release): https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.329

item.title: AI-Designed Frostbite CPU Outperforms Modern Chips
item.description: AI systems discovered, designed, and verified a new CPU called Frostbite, achieving 4.59x better performance-per-watt than modern CPUs. The design addresses the stagnation in CPU core improvement and offers a novel approach to general-purpose CPU architecture. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://architectlabs.com/blog/frostbite

item.title: RL post-training in diffusion transformers is activation steering, achieving 90% of gains with…
item.description: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training significantly improves diffusion transformers' visual and text rendering quality, with minimal internal settings changes. The study addresses the challenge of improving complex AI model outputs with minimal computational overhead. — Upstream (arXiv): https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26627v1

item.title: vLLM v0.34.0
item.description: vLLM v0.34.0 introduces 10 new models and enhances the default behavior of the short-term working notes cache, which is now automatically sized based on available memory, potentially improving throughput and performance. The update addresses memory management and model performance issues, ensuring better resource utilization and faster processing times. — Upstream (vLLM Release): https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/releases/tag/v0.34.0

item.title: langchain-openrouter==0.3.0
item.description: langchain-openrouter 0.3.0 dropped support for Python 3.10, now requiring Python 3.11, and updated the minimum langchain-core version to 1.8.3. The update addresses the end-of-life status of Python 3.10, ensuring compatibility and security for users. — Upstream (LangChain Release): https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/releases/tag/langchain-openrouter%3D%3D0.3.0

item.title: Google Workers Push Back Against AI Policy in Schools
item.description: Google workers are protesting a policy that would block schools from using its Gemini AI tools if they don't want them, and communities across the country are organizing protests. The issue is about balancing the use of AI in education with the autonomy of schools and parents to decide what tech is appropriate for their students. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://www.motherjones.com/politics/2026/11/google-alphabet-union-school-ai-protest-gemini-workers-petition/

item.title: Riemann Hypothesis May Have Been Solved with AI Assistance
item.description: A user claims that Claude, an AI, may have assisted in potentially solving the Riemann Hypothesis, a long-standing mathematical problem. The user states, 'what I saw during the course of progress so amazed me that I believe it is one dawn across science of something far greater.' The Riemann Hypothesis, a conjecture about the distribution of prime numbers, has been a central problem in mathematics for over a century. potentially solving it could have profound implications for number theory and related fields. — Upstream (Bluesky · @emollick): https://bsky.app/profile/emollick.bsky.social/post/3n2qvqp4fts2e

item.title: Epic Games Uses AI for Unreal Engine Development
item.description: Epic Games is integrating AI into the Unreal Engine to aid in coding and development processes. The goal is to enhance the efficiency and creativity in game development, potentially reducing the time and effort required for coding. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://spectrum.ieee.org/epic-games-unreal-engine-ai

item.title: Romanian lawyer barred from representing applicants before court over unverified AI-generated…
item.description: A Romanian lawyer was barred from representing applicants before the European Court for two years after submitting unverified AI-generated citations that contained numerous errors, including non-existent cases and irrelevant or contradictory information. Reportedly (unverified): the incident underscores the need for rigorous verification of AI-generated content, especially in legal contexts where accuracy is paramount. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://www.echr.coe.int/w/romanian-lawyer-barred-for-two-years-from-representing-applicants-before-the-court-over-unverified-ai-generated-citations

item.title: 35 Human Labs Deploy digital helpers for Science Collaboration
item.description: 35 human labs deployed digital helpers that worked together to publish 936 scientific papers, publicly retracted mistakes, and founded a peer review journal. The initiative aimed to improve the efficiency and accuracy of scientific research through collaborative AI systems. — Upstream (Bluesky · @emollick): https://bsky.app/profile/emollick.bsky.social/post/3n2pqcy4cbs2g

item.title: Apple is Building a digital helpers to Browse Web, Work Across Apps
item.description: Apple is hiring an engineer to develop a digital helpers that can browse the web, work across apps, and perform various tasks like writing code and calling services. Apple aims to enhance user experience by creating a digital helpers that can assist in managing multiple applications and tasks more efficiently. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://www.theverge.com/tech/1038227/apple-ai-agent-engineer-job-listing

item.title: Court Rules AI-Generated Probable Cause Invalid Under 4th Amendment
item.description: A court ruled that AI-generated probable cause cannot be used in legal proceedings, as it does not meet the standards set by the 4th Amendment. The ruling addresses the potential misuse of AI in law enforcement, ensuring that probable cause must be based on human judgment. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://www.techdirt.com/2026/11/19/court-tells-cops-that-the-4th-amendment-doesnt-cover-ai-generated-probable-cause/

item.title: Distillation reproduces powerful AI capabilities without safeguards, raising banking security…
item.description: A new research project from OpenAI explores how distillation can reproduce powerful AI capabilities without the safeguards built around them. The research aims to address the potential security and compliance risks associated with distillation, ensuring that AI models used in banking are secure and reliable. — Upstream (X · @OpenAI): https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2123862344422088794

item.title: MedChemBench: A new benchmark for AI reasoning in medicinal chemistry
item.description: MedChemBench is a new benchmark introduced for evaluating AI reasoning in medicinal chemistry, allowing for the assessment of AI systems in drug discovery tasks. It addresses the need for a standardized method to test and validate AI systems in the complex and critical field of medicinal chemistry. — Upstream (X · @OpenAI): https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2123856316187975756

item.title: Levent Alpöge Claims Proof of Riemann Hypothesis and Beyond
item.description: Levent Alpöge claims to have proven the Riemann Hypothesis with Claude, extending the proof to the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis and potentially the Extended Riemann Hypothesis. The claim addresses a long-standing mathematical conjecture that has implications for number theory and cryptography. — Upstream (Simon Willison): https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/20/levent-alpoge/

item.title: Combatting Adversarial Distillation to Safeguard Model Outputs
item.description: OpenAI developed a layered approach to protect against adversarial distillation, where models can be used to extract and reproduce advanced capabilities without proper safeguards. The problem is the risk of bad actors using advanced AI models to create unauthorized, less secure models that could pose safety and security threats. — Upstream (OpenAI News): https://openai.com/index/combatting-adversarial-distillation
